tool.help:
**Biomni: Analyze Radiolabeled Antibody Biodistribution**
Analyze biodistribution and pharmacokinetic profile of radiolabeled antibodies.
Parameters ---------- time_points : list or numpy.ndarray Time points (hours) at which measurements were taken tissue_data : dict Dictionary where keys are tissue names and values are lists/arrays of %IA/g measurements corresponding to time_points. Must include 'tumor' as one of the keys.
Returns ------- str Research log summarizing the biodistribution analysis, pharmacokinetic parameters, and tumor-to-normal tissue ratios
**Domain**: pharmacology **Function**: analyze_radiolabeled_antibody_biodistribution
